title: Once upgrade to Max, all requests returned internal_server_error
body:
**Bug Description**
I have upgraded to Max plan, but once I finished placing the order all Claude APIs are now returning internal_server_error. I tried logging out and in again on Claude Code, it doesn't work. Then I tried Claude web, Claude desktop and Claude app. All requests returned internal_server_error. I am no longer able to use my Claude account at all.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.30
- Feedback ID: d2ec0a25-d112-45b4-a7ee-744d9bc4ba25

**Errors**
